mentions.name: Custom unit design game prototype
mentions.description: This is an indie game prototype in early exploration. The developer is prototyping game ideas full-time for six months, circling around narrative, simulations, and zachlikes, and is currently testing custom unit design: how designing units (like RollerCoaster Tycoon's coaster design mapping to stats such as excitement ratings) could mix with old school point buy systems, as a small 'toy' experiment to find a kernel they enjoy tinkering with.
mentions.source_excerpt: Currently I'm trying to work out if there's anything interesting in custom unit design, basically unpicking how games like rollercoaster tycoon's coaster design maps to stats like excitement ratings and seeing how that might mix with old school point buy systems
